title: Whisk declared workflow graph
description: A *.graph.yaml file named by functions[].graph in whisk.yaml. Step ids are the contract with the step names used in code.

stepId.description: A step name as used in code. Ids ending in ? are decision nodes and need not exist in code.

target.description: A step id, or end to finish the workflow.

kind.description: run: a step.run (default). approval: a step.approval that waits for a human. sleep: a step.sleep or sleepUntil. wait: a step.waitForEvent.

next.description: Id of the step that follows, or end. Absent: the next step in the list, or end for the last step.

branches.description: Decision nodes only: label to target. Every branch of a decision must be listed.

label.description: Human text shown on the node instead of the id.
